To Whom It May Concern, I'm writing to provide a personal account of what happened on 05/14/2026. While driving northbound on Sierra Parkway around 10:42 AM, a road stone struck the windshield of my 2022 Hyundai IONIQ 5 SE. I heard the impact and saw a small chip right in the center, in front of the Camera area. Within few minutes, the crack spread across the camera viewing area toward the passenger side. No collision occurred. No other vehicles were involved and I did not hit anything. There were no injuries and no airbag deployment. The car remained drivable and I was able to continue safely. I contacted Grove Mobile Glass & Scan and they are arranging mobile glass replacement and camera calibration for me. Please let me know if you need any additional details.
